component.name: flexiv_rdk
component.description: Flexiv RDK prebuilt shared library, including Flexiv's own internal libraries. All thirdparty dependencies except Eigen are statically embedded and symbol-hidden.

components.name: boost
components.description: Header-only use by RBDyn.

components.name: eigen
components.description: Header-only linear algebra library used in the public API. Not embedded: the consumer provides it through find_package(Eigen3).
